name: ak:plan
overview: Plan implementations, design architectures, create technical roadmaps with detailed phases. Use for feature planning, system design, solution architecture, implementation strategy, phase documentation, editorial self-contained HTML plan artifacts with --html, and AgentWiki publishing with --wiki.
whenToUse: Invoke when work needs phases, architecture, or a roadmap.

flags.name: --tdd
flags.desc: Add tests-first structure to each phase for regression-safe refactors

flags.name: --html
flags.desc: Output a self-contained editorial interactive HTML plan with visible phase outlines, markdown detail modals, and optional generated watercolor technical sketch imagery

flags.name: --github
flags.desc: Create or update a GitHub issue after plan validation with branch, summary, plan links, open questions, and ready to review

flags.name: --wiki
flags.desc: Publish the final reviewed plan docs or HTML artifact to AgentWiki via CLI or MCP when available
